title: Binary-choice machine code
statement: A code for a binary-choice Turing machine consists of a natural number $k$ of work tapes, a natural number $m$ such that the machine has state set $	ext{Fin}(m+1)$, and the machine itself, whose input alphabet is Boolean and whose transitions are indexed by a choice bit.
